items_flat.title_en: Anthropic commits 5% of shares to new Public Benefit Fund that can grow with valuation
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 承諾將 5% 股份投入新公益基金，並可隨估值成長
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic announced it is committing a portion of its shares to the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, a wholly owned LLC. Subject to stockholder approval, 5% of shares are committed immediately, with an additional 2% possible at board discretion for every 50% increase in company value above a set baseline. Combined with prior co-founder and employee pledges, roughly 20% of shares are now dedicated to public benefit, and the Fund will not be used for lobbying or political giving.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布將部分股份投入全新全資擁有的 Anthropic 公益基金（LLC）。待股東批准後，立即承諾 5% 股份，並在公司價值較基準每增加 50% 時，董事會可酌情再增 2%。加上先前共同創辦人與員工承諾，約 20% 股份已投入公益，且基金不得用於遊說或政治捐贈。
items_flat.analysis_en: The structure ties a growing ownership stake to public benefit as Anthropic approaches a large IPO, offering a concrete mechanism beyond one-time pledges, though governance details and exact valuation milestones remain to be specified.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此結構在 Anthropic 即將進行大型 IPO 之際，將成長中的持股與公益掛鉤，提供超越一次性承諾的具體機制，但治理細節與確切估值里程碑仍待明確。
items_flat.quote: Subject to stockholder approval, 5% of Anthropic’s shares will be committed today, with an additional 2% added at the board’s discretion for every 50% increase in the company’s value above a set baseline.
items_flat.quote_zh: 待股東批准後，今日即承諾 Anthropic 5% 股份，並在公司價值較設定基準每增加 50% 時，董事會可酌情再增 2%。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI upgrades GPT-6 Pro in ChatGPT with parallel agents and collaborative Slides
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 升級 ChatGPT 中的 GPT-6 Pro，加入平行代理人與協作簡報
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced that GPT-6 Pro (also referenced as GPT-6 Astra Pro) in the Chat tab now delivers faster responses, better plugin and tool use, and support for multiple agents working on different parts of a task in parallel, with visible progress and the ability to open completed work. The update is available to Pro users; the same release notes also introduced ChatGPT Slides for collaborative presentation creation and export on eligible plans.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布 Chat 分頁中的 GPT-6 Pro（亦稱 GPT-6 Astra Pro）現提供更快回應、更好的外掛與工具使用，並支援多個代理人平行處理任務不同部分，進度可見且可開啟已完成工作。此更新對 Pro 用戶開放；同期發行說明亦推出 ChatGPT Slides，供符合資格方案進行協作簡報建立與匯出。
items_flat.analysis_en: Parallel agents mark a concrete step from single-threaded chat toward multi-agent workflows inside the consumer product, though availability remains limited to higher-tier plans and independent performance data is still limited.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 平行代理人標誌著消費產品從單線程對話邁向多代理人工作流的具體一步，但目前僅限較高階方案，且獨立效能數據仍有限。
items_flat.quote: And now, multiple agents can tackle different parts of a task in parallel. You can follow each agent’s progress and open completed tasks to review their work. Now available to Pro users in the Chat tab.
items_flat.quote_zh: 現在，多個代理人可平行處理任務的不同部分。您可追蹤每個代理人的進度，並開啟已完成任務以檢視其工作。現已對 Chat 分頁的 Pro 用戶開放。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic reports junior technical hiring drop and agents logging 6x human hours
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 報告初級技術招聘下降，代理人時數達人類 6 倍
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic published internal research showing that the share of junior technical hires fell from 27% to 9% over roughly a year, while technical roles as a share of the workforce declined from 61% to 56%. By August 2026, employee-directed Claude agents were logging about six times the active work hours of human staff, though the company notes its AI-native workflows may not fully generalize.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 發表內部研究顯示，初級技術招聘占比約一年內從 27% 降至 9%，技術職位占勞動力比例從 61% 降至 56%。至 2026 年 8 月，員工引導的 Claude 代理人活躍工時約達人類員工的 6 倍，但公司指出其 AI 原生工作流未必能完全外推。
items_flat.analysis_en: The data offers a rare inside view of how heavy agent adoption can reshape hiring and work composition at a frontier lab, though Anthropic notes its AI-native workflows may not fully translate to other organizations.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這些數據罕見地從內部視角顯示重度代理人採用如何重塑前沿實驗室的招聘與工作組成，但 Anthropic 指出其 AI 原生工作流未必能完全適用於其他組織。
items_flat.quote: By August, there were six times more agents than employees at Anthropic, and productivity increased.
items_flat.quote_zh: 到八月，Anthropic 的代理數量已是員工的六倍，生產力也隨之提升。

items_flat.title_en: DeepSeek releases V4.1-Flash-1017 with stronger agent scores and open weights
items_flat.title_zh: DeepSeek 發布 V4.1-Flash-1017，代理人分數更強並開放權重
items_flat.summary_en: DeepSeek shipped DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, a minor update to its previous Flash model that improves scores across agentic and coding benchmarks (including 77.0 on DeepSWE v1.1 versus 74.0 for Claude Opus 5 in the company’s table), finishes tasks faster with shorter outputs, and is available with open weights under MIT on Hugging Face as well as via its website, app, and API.
items_flat.summary_zh: DeepSeek 推出 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017，為先前 Flash 模型的小幅更新，在代理人與程式基準上分數提升（公司表格中 DeepSWE v1.1 達 77.0，對比 Claude Opus 5 的 74.0），任務完成更快且輸出更短，並以 MIT 開源權重於 Hugging Face 提供，同時可透過其網站、應用與 API 使用。
items_flat.analysis_en: The update strengthens the cost-performance case for open-weight agentic models relative to closed frontier options on specific coding benchmarks, though independent verification of the reported gains is still limited.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此更新強化了開源權重代理人模型在特定程式基準上相對於封閉前沿選項的性價比論述，但所報提升的獨立驗證仍有限。
items_flat.quote: Stronger benchmark performance, faster task completion, and shorter outputs than the previous version—a Pareto improvement in performance and cost.
items_flat.quote_zh: 比先前版本更強的基準表現、更快的任務完成與更短的輸出——在效能與成本上的帕累托改進。

items_flat.title_en: Meta removes controversial AI training language from updated commercial terms after backlash
items_flat.title_zh: Meta 在反彈後從更新商業條款中移除爭議 AI 訓練語言
items_flat.summary_en: Meta updated its commercial terms and then removed language that critics said could allow the company to crawl business customers’ websites and use the content to train AI models. A Meta spokesperson stated the crawling provisions only apply in limited circumstances and that there was no substantive change in practice.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta 更新商業條款後，移除了批評者指可能允許公司爬取企業客戶網站並將內容用於訓練 AI 模型的語言。Meta 發言人表示，爬蟲條款僅適用於有限情況，且實務上並無實質改變。
items_flat.analysis_en: The rapid walk-back highlights ongoing sensitivity around web-crawling rights for AI training, especially for publishers, even as Meta maintains there was no substantive change in policy.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 迅速撤回凸顯了 AI 訓練網頁爬蟲權利的持續敏感，尤其對出版商而言，即使 Meta 強調政策並無實質改變。
items_flat.quote: We’ve heard you and want to clarify: the crawling terms we consolidated only applied to our ads and business products, and we’ve clarified that in the terms themselves. It does not change how Meta uses web crawlers.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們已聽到你們的聲音並想澄清：我們整合的爬取條款僅適用於廣告與商業產品，我們已在條款中澄清。這不改變Meta使用網頁爬蟲的方式。

items_flat.title_en: OpenCode reports breach exposing OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google API keys for some users
items_flat.title_zh: OpenCode 報告外洩事件，部分用戶的 OpenAI、Anthropic 與 Google API 金鑰曝光
items_flat.summary_en: OpenCode disclosed unauthorized access to a legacy system it was decommissioning, stating that third-party provider API keys (including OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google) saved by about 1.4% of Console users may have been exposed in what it described as a limited incident.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenCode 披露其正在退役的舊系統遭到未授權存取，表示約 1.4% Console 用戶儲存的第三方供應商 API 金鑰（包括 OpenAI、Anthropic 與 Google）可能已曝光，並將其描述為有限事件。
items_flat.analysis_en: The incident underscores the security risks of third-party tools that store frontier-lab API keys, with limited public detail so far on the full scope or confirmed misuse beyond initial reports.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此事件凸顯了儲存前沿實驗室 API 金鑰的第三方工具安全風險，目前公開細節有限，尚未確認全面範圍或實際濫用。
items_flat.quote: We had a security breach last night related to a large scale distillation attack that impacted 1.4% of OpenCode Console users. We have notified them all this morning via email... we are working with Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google to remediate.
items_flat.quote_zh: 昨晚發生與大規模蒸餾攻擊相關的安全外洩，影響1.4%的OpenCode Console用戶。我們今早已透過電郵通知所有受影響者……我們正與Anthropic、OpenAI與Google合作修復。
